newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel sees telecoms sales rise with mkt.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel sees telecoms sales rise with mkt.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom believes its telecoms sales could grow in line with the global market in the wake of the World Trade Organisation deal on liberalisation reached at the weekend, Alcatel Telecom managing director Jozef Cornu said on Wednesday.
But Cornu told a news conference he was cautious about WTO predictions of the world telecoms market expanding to $1,200 billion in the year 2000 from $670 billion in 1996.
"The market will not double in such a short time. It will double but not in two to four years. It could rise by 50 percent," he said.
"In this case, a 50 percent rise in Alcatel's turnover in telecoms is possible," he said, adding that this would happen despite a 10 percent drop on average in the price of equipment each year.
The group had a turnover of 71.15 billion francs last year in telecoms, out of a total of 161.97 billion francs.
